introHtml: Custom NFC enabled pens combine the practicality of a writing instrument with the power of contactless technology. Tap the pen to any smartphone to instantly share a website, digital business card, or social media profile. Ideal for tradeshow giveaways and sales teams, these pens create a memorable, interactive experience that sets your brand apart from standard promotional giveaways.
